set: LEGO Technic 42175 Volvo EC230 Electric Excavator (excavator booklet, bags 12-17)

input.model_so_far: Base with two rails, four rail pegs, two roller carriers (step 9).

new_parts.name: trk-axle5-1
new_parts.position: grey 5-long axle pushed through the front end of each rail and into a sprocket wheel

new_parts.name: trk-axle5-2
new_parts.position: grey 5-long axle pushed through the front end of each rail and into a sprocket wheel

new_parts.name: trk-sprocket-1
new_parts.catalog_name: Technic Tread Sprocket Wheel Small 6 Tooth
new_parts.position: 6-tooth black sprocket wheel on the end of each axle

new_parts.name: trk-sprocket-2
new_parts.catalog_name: Technic Tread Sprocket Wheel Small 6 Tooth
new_parts.position: 6-tooth black sprocket wheel on the end of each axle

what_each_new_part_touches: In the yellow box (2x) the axle is pushed into the sprocket's centre; the two sprockets then go onto the front end of each rail (arrows).
where_everything_is_after: one sprocket sits at the front end of each rail on its own axle

why.problem_solved: Starts the drive end of the track: the sprockets are the wheels whose teeth will grab the track links.
why.why_these_parts: The axle locks into the sprocket's cross hole but turns freely in the round beam hole, so the sprocket can spin.
why.sets_up_for_later: Step 11 does the same at the other end.

review_note: Which rail hole holds the axle is an estimate. The booklet part is a light grey axle with a ridge; read as Technic Axle 5 (1:1 callout not shown for this step).
